caption: The drawing is monochromatic, created with pencil on light-colored paper, and depicts an oval-shaped medallion or emblem bordered by a wreath of laurel leaves. Inside the oval border, there are three male busts in circular frames arranged in a horizontal row—one in the center and two on either side. The man in the center is facing forward, while the men on the left and right are shown in profile, facing toward the center. Above the busts, within the border, the words "IN REMEMBRANCE" are prominently inscribed in large, uppercase letters. Beneath the busts, there is a partial representation of a shield with branches on either side, and the phrases “CONQUERED ONLY BY DEATH,” “FIRST IN PEACE,” and “CHARITY FOR ALL” are written in a curved formation following the oval’s shape. The lines and shading are detailed but soft, giving a uniform, grayscale appearance. The artist's signature, "C. Ward," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Platter
